from io import BytesIO
import boto3
import pandas as pd

bucket = "dataforge-academy-919774751018-gold"
key = "demo-aws/entrega-final/tareas_por_usuario/gold_v1/tareas_por_usuario.parquet"

response = boto3.client("s3", region_name="us-east-1").get_object(
    Bucket=bucket, Key=key
)
df = pd.read_parquet(BytesIO(response["Body"].read()))
df = df.sort_values("userId")

print("CONTENIDO REAL DE GOLD")
print(df.to_string(index=False))

assert len(df) == 8, "Se esperaban 8 filas"
assert set(df["userId"]) == set(range(1, 9)), "Usuarios inesperados"
assert df["total_tareas"].eq(20).all(), "Conteos inesperados"
assert df["total_tareas"].sum() == 160, "Total inesperado"

print("VERIFICACION CORRECTA: 8 usuarios, 20 tareas cada uno, total 160.")
